title: Review analytical batch
purpose: Approve or return current submitted revisions in one batch that you neither entered nor submitted, using holding, preservation, preparation and QC evidence.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: These are staff pages. Active users with an application staff role can read them; client accounts cannot. Analysts perform result entry and batch work, reviewers decide results, and administrators maintain configuration. Administrators also have operational analyst and reviewer access, but independence rules still apply. Superuser status alone does not grant an application role.

items.label: Batch
items.description: Number links to current membership, entry and QC. Method, matrix and optional primary equipment identify the run. Equipment is informational.

items.label: Results awaiting review
items.description: Only latest submitted revisions entered in this batch are candidates. Rows are fixed by lab ID then analyte. Counts show filtered matches versus all current pending revisions.

items.label: Search
items.description: Partial case-insensitive match in lab ID or frozen analyte name. Unlike batch detail, client sample ID is not searched here.

items.label: Show
items.description: All awaiting review, Ready to approve, Held (QC or holding time), or My own work. Held also includes applicable preservation/preparation blockers. My own work means you entered or submitted the revision. Invalid filters show errors and no rows.

items.label: Open QC findings
items.description: Each current unresolved analytical QC issue is listed once with its disposition/conflict state. It holds the affected definitions; Record disposition, shown to analysts and reviewers, opens its separate assessment.

items.label: QC sample
items.description: QC label linked conceptually to its owning batch; Type identifies blank, LCS, spike/duplicate or calibration QC.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Analyte represented by the current measurement.

items.label: Observed
items.description: Original text and unit.

items.label: Evaluation
items.description: Current Pass, Fail or Not evaluated under active limits.

items.label: Detail
items.description: Value/recovery/RPD calculation and limits explanation.

items.label: Frequency not met
items.description: QC type and configured required count versus QC samples present.

items.label: Recorded dispositions
items.description: Latest disposition per finding, actor and note. A disposition resolves only its matching current context.

items.label: Sample
items.description: Lab ID opens the result page with all revisions and provenance.

items.label: Can approve?
items.description: Your work: another person must decide. Held: row-specific blockers and/or count of analytical/preparation QC findings. Ready: independent and no current blockers were found. Held rows can still be returned.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Frozen analyte name; later revisions show their revision number.

items.label: Prepared aliquot
items.description: Linked preparation batch/aliquot label or Not linked.

items.label: Result
items.description: Original supplied number or ND with its applied reporting-limit threshold. Non-detects are not shown as zero.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Frozen unit and soil basis/solids information where applicable.

items.label: Reporting limit
items.description: Exact limit applied to this revision.

items.label: Qualifiers
items.description: Recorded code snapshots with description tooltip.

items.label: Holding
items.description: Entry-time holding status.

items.label: Analyst
items.description: Person who entered the revision; a different submitter is also identified when applicable.

items.label: Dilution
items.description: Applied factor; hidden initially.

items.label: Analysis start
items.description: Recorded start; hidden initially.

items.label: Preservation assessment
items.description: On held rows, open this test’s current preservation evidence/disposition.

items.label: Batch QC
items.description: Jump to the shared QC evidence section for the finding count affecting this row.

items.label: Select all results you may review on this page
items.description: Select independent rows on this page, including held ones. Your own work has no checkbox. Selections do not carry between pages.

items.label: Select only ready to approve
items.description: Select independent visible rows without currently detected blockers.

items.label: Action
items.description: Required Approve or Return, applied to selected current candidates.

items.label: Note or reason
items.description: Required nonblank reason for Return, optional note for Approve. Recorded with the decision.

items.label: Apply decision to selected
items.description: Only reviewers can decide. Each selected result is processed independently; successful rows can commit while blocked/stale rows are reported. Wrong-batch, no-longer-current and no-longer-submitted selections are skipped, as is your own work.

sections.title: Approval and independence rules
paragraphs: You cannot approve or return a revision you entered or submitted, even with administrator or combined analyst/reviewer roles. That is the independence this page enforces for results: recording the batch’s QC samples or measurements does not by itself stop you from approving its results, and whether it should is the laboratory’s own policy. Only accepting a QC finding is refused to whoever measured that QC (see below). An independent reviewer may return held work with a reason; return preserves the observation and asks the analyst for a new revision.

Approve rechecks current state under transaction locks. Holding exceedance needs a frozen qualifier marked for holding time. Missing required clock events, backwards preparation chronology, preparation timestamp divergence, invalid/missing required aliquots, current preservation blockers, unresolved analytical QC and linked preparation QC all block approval. An entry with no configured holding rule is shown as not evaluated rather than assigned a fabricated limit.

QC failures, unevaluated/missing measurements and frequency shortfalls must be corrected or independently accepted for their current context. A reviewer who measured the QC or entered/submitted affected results cannot accept the finding. A prior disposition can stop matching when measurements, limits or membership counts change.

Approve records reviewer/time/note, marks the latest revision and result approved, and freezes the QC evidence relied on. It does not issue a report. Report release is a separate explicitly authorized action with its own current-state recheck.

sections.title: Filtering and table controls

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters to the entire matching dataset and return to page 1. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; they never widen the query.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search and filters and restore this page’s defaults. A filter chip removes only that filter.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: Choose 25 (default), 50 or 100. First, Previous, Next and Last page links retain filters. Counts describe all matching records.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show or hide optional columns and change their order using movement controls or header dragging. Changes apply immediately and are saved for this table in this browser. Locked columns stay available.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restore the original column visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog.

paragraphs: Filtering and pagination affect pending result rows, not the batch-wide QC section. There are no sortable headings for result rows.

sections.title: Laboratory records
paragraphs: This section shows today’s records for information. It does not establish conditions when work occurred or grant/block entry, approval or release. Empty stock-use, nonconformance or capability lists say no matching record is shown, not that a staff member is unqualified.

items.label: Standards and reagents used
items.description: Material name, linked Lot, signed quantity Used with unit, When, By and Notes show stock-use movements recorded against this batch. Use later reversed and Used after expiry flags preserve context.

items.label: Open nonconformances
items.description: Linked open records show number, title, status, severity and owner. Open a number for details. A count notes any closed linked records.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: Asset links show current Status, Calibration due and Maintenance due. Due state is based on today; a date before today is overdue, a date within 30 days is due soon. Last not acceptable flags the latest calibration outcome.

items.label: Current demonstrations of capability
items.description: Staff, linked Record, Effective and Expires show current matching method and matrix records. Admin, reviewer, approver and project-manager roles see all staff; other staff see their own records only. No expiry set means the record has no expiry date.

sections.title: Empty and changed work
paragraphs: Nothing awaiting review means no latest submitted revisions remain in this batch. Clear filters if only the filtered view is empty. Staff without reviewer access see a read-only notice. No selection or a missing return reason stays on the page with errors. Refusals show grouped reasons and affected results; inspect current state before retrying.
